title: Candidate flow heatmap + headcount contingency notes (scratch)
content:
Purpose:
Quick scratchpad for upcoming hc-sync (1:1 with Lina) + weekly hiring triage. Focus: understanding where candidates are getting stuck, short-term contingency scenarios (Q1 hires slipping), and debrief action items that reduce time-to-offer and improve ramp predictability.

Meeting goals (30–45m):
- Surface candidate funnel chokepoints (by role/loop stage)
- Agree on 2 mitigation levers to deploy this week if offers slip
- Decide follow-ups and owners for interview calibration + onboarding checklist updates

Context / current snapshot (rolling numbers pulled 2026-02-25):
- Roles prioritized this quarter: Infra SRE (4 IC), LLM Runtime Eng (3 IC), Product Data Scientist (2 IC), Developer Experience PM (1 PM).
- Funnel (total open reqs = 10):
  - New applicants screened: 210
  - Recruiter screens completed: 82
  - Hiring-manager screens scheduled: 48
  - On-site / loop invites sent: 23
  - On-site completed: 16
  - Offers extended: 6
  - Offers accepted: 3
- Time to offer (median): 28 days (target 21)
- Offer acceptance rate: 50% last 30d (target 70%)
- Top friction observed: scheduling delays between HM screen -> loop (avg 9 days), inconsistent debrief notes causing re-interviews, compensation negotiation misalignment on LLM Runtime banding.

Heatmap quick view (where candidates drop):
- Early funnel (recruiter -> HM screen): ~61% conversion (ok)
- HM screen -> loop invite: ~58% conversion (scheduling delays + unclear role scope)
- Loop -> offer: ~37% conversion (interviewer alignment + score variance)
- Offer -> accept: 50% (counteroffers and clarity on career path concerns)

Hypotheses (what's causing slips):
1) Interview loop is too long and ad-hoc; panels not calibrated on rubric. Some interviewers default to conservative scoring.
2) Compensation band guidance for LLM Runtime roles is outdated vs market comps (remote candidates) -> longer negotiation cycles.
3) Onboarding & ramp expectations not clearly communicated in offer conversations (candidates worry about unclear success metrics).

Immediate mitigation levers (pick 2 this week):
A. "Loop compression" experiment: reserve 2 full-days/month where hiring managers + core interviewers commit to back-to-back loops for key roles. Owner: Ethan. Timeline: run one day next Thu (2026-03-05).
B. Calibration huddle: 30m interview rubric sync for Runtime + SRE interviewers; produce one-pager "what passes" for each role. Owner: Priya. Due: 2026-03-03.
C. Compensation quick-refresh: CS to share latest comp comps and suggest immediate +5–10% flexible buckets for remote hires. Owner: Noor. Deliverable: updated band memo by 2026-03-04.
D. Fast-offer pathway: for prioritized pipelines (top 4 roles), allow hiring manager to greenlight verbal offer after loop if score >= 85% and recruiter confirms comp band alignment. Owner: Lina (policy).

Debrief checklist (post-loop) - try to make mandatory fields in debrief form:
- "Clear recommend / borderline / decline" (pick one)
- Top 2 strengths and top 1 weakness (bullet points)
- Required level / band justification (1 line)
- Candidate concerns raised during loop (notes)
- Do we need reference checks before offer? (yes/no)
- Suggested start date / notice assumptions
- Interviewer calibration flag (yes/no) -> if yes, trigger 15m calibration with HM + interviewer

Onboarding & ramp notes (pre-empt candidate questions):
- First 30 days: setup, one core project goal, assigned buddy, scheduled role onboarding sessions.
- 90-day milestone: independent ownership of a prioritized serving/runtime subcomponent + first perf metric target.
- Documented ramp plan will be attached to offer email (standardize language). Owner: People Ops (Priya to draft template).

Headcount contingency scenarios (quick A/B/C):
- Conservative (A): hiring velocity slows 30% -> we hire 5 of 10 planned by EOY. Actions: defer non-critical reqs, shift 1 headcount from infra to runtime via re-prioritization.
- Baseline (B): current funnel holds -> hire 7–8/10. Actions: run loop compression + comp refresh.
- Aggressive (C): funnel improves + higher conversion -> 10/10. Actions: increase interview capacity, allocate 2 more recruiters, open interview weekend.
Key trigger metrics to choose scenario by 2026-03-15: median time-to-offer <= 21d, offer accept rate >= 65%, HM screen -> loop scheduling median <= 3d.

Risk register (short):
- Biggest immediate risk: losing 2 SRE candidates to counteroffers in last 2 weeks. Mitigation: faster verbal offers + retention perk (signing bonus).
- Risk: interview fatigue -> interviewer attrition for busy eng teams. Mitigation: rotate pool + hire contract interviewers for peak windows.

Questions for 1:1 with Lina (agenda bullets):
- Do we approve the loop compression day and commit manager time? Any conflicts?
- Temporary approval to allow verbal offers per fast-offer pathway for 4 priority roles? (policy + legal review needed)
- Budget approval for comp quick-refresh (one-off flexibility for Q1 hires) and potential signing bonuses?
- How aggressive do we want to be on recruiter headcount if scenario C looks likely?

Action items to assign (this doc = scratch -> convert to GH/Asana after 1:1):
- Priya: draft 1-page calibration rubric + onboarding offer template. Due 2026-03-03.
- Ethan: schedule loop compression day + confirm interviewer list. Due 2026-03-02.
- Noor: compile comp benchmarks + recommend flexible bands. Due 2026-03-04.
- Lina: decide on verbal-offer policy + budget guardrails. Due 2026-03-05.
- Recruiter (TBD): prepare fast-offer checklist and candidate messaging templates. Due 2026-03-04.

Notes to self (things to capture in final doc):
- Capture before/after metrics for any change (TT_OFFER, ACCEPT_RATE, HM->LOOP days) and compare week-over-week for 6 weeks.
- If loop compression works, consider repeating monthly for top buckets.
- Keep candidate-facing language around ramp realistic and measurable (avoid vague phrases like "rapid growth opportunity").

Quick follow-ups after meeting (prep for 7-day pulse):
- Confirm owners + calendar holds for compression day
- Publish calibration one-pager as living doc on Confluence and link in reqs
- Update offer template with 90-day milestone
- Track immediate effect on 3 candidates in final loop (monitor their outcomes)

Free-form notes / scratch (brain dump):
- Could test "offer sweetener" A/B: higher base vs small guaranteed bonus. Measure acceptance delta.
- Consider interviewing weekend model: 1 Sat every 6 weeks with stipends for interviewers.
- Ask Lina whether we can temporarily allow internal transfers to cover infra gaps (might be faster than external hires).

-- end scratch --

(Will trim and formalize if leadership wants a doc to share)
